scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@apexfusion/vector-mcp-builder && npm run build --workspace=@apexfusion/vector-mcp-signer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/builder && tsc --noEmit -p packages/signer
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node --import tsx --test packages/builder/test/smoke/*.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke:signer: npm run build && node --import tsx --test packages/signer/test/smoke/*.test.ts
